card.name: Indication lists in TNF-blocker labels
card.fires_on: Linking words and commas inside lists of autoimmune conditions (arthritis, psoriasis, uveitis, colitis) in TNF-blocker dosing headings and trial text, e.g. "patients with" or a comma between disease names. Also partway through brand names like SIMPONI.

modes.label: Linking word before a disease
modes.description: The word "with" or "or" after patients or adults, just before an inflammatory disease name.
